title: Halting-word transformation
statement: For a Boolean list $x$, run the loop defined by the fourth-power step on the encoding of the pair whose first component is the remainder of $x$ after removing its unary prefix and whose second component encodes that same remainder together with the one-element list containing true. Then take the second decoded component twice successively.
caveat: The meaning and stopping behavior of the loop and the pairing and unary-prefix operations are not provided, so their construction cannot be expressed in more standard terms.
